messages:
Maria: Hey team — PR #19884 blocked by flaky mac-smoke image-snapshot. Failing on `AvatarRender.test` only in CI, passes locally. Anyone around to quick-eyes? :wave:
Alan: :eyes: I can take a look in ~30m. Can you paste the failing diff or logs?
Maria: Thanks! Here's the failing assertion from CI:
```
AvatarRender.test › renders avatar with badge
- expected image to match snapshot
+ received different pixels at (128,64)
```
Priya: That line looks like font fallback. Did we change any font bundles in the branch?
Maria: Not intentionally. Branch only updates rendering buffer alignment. I did run visual locally at 2x and looked fine.
ci-bot: Build #4821 failed on mac-smoke (job shard 4). Rerun command: `/retest mac-smoke shard=4`
Jordan: Quick hypothesis: CI uses system fonts on runner image; local dev uses local cached fonts. Can we force a fallback in test or pin deterministic font?
Sam: If it's just one pixel offset, could be antialiasing due to different renderer flags. Try adding `pixelTolerance: 2` to the snapshot compare for that test.
Maria: OK will try a targeted rerun first. Doing `/retest mac-smoke shard=4` now.
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled (build #4822).
Alan: If rerun fails, let's capture full PNG from CI and attach to PR so we can compare. Also include `--headless-render` flag in test to match CI render path.
Maria: Rerun came back: still failing, same diff. attaching CI artifact: https://ci.example.com/artifacts/4822/avatar_diff.png
Priya: Confirmed — the CI image shows slightly different anti-aliased edge on the badge. I'm +1 to either allow small pixel slack or update snapshot if change intentional.
Jordan: I can add `pixelTolerance: 3` and a short note in the test. Will open small PR and link back.
Maria: Prefer to avoid snapshot update unless behavior changed. Jordan, can you add the tolerance and we can land quickly?
Jordan: Yep. I'll open PR with test tweak and link to this thread. ETA 15m.
Sam: :thumbsup: after Jordan's PR lands please queue a full mac-smoke run and unhold merge.
Maria: Thanks everyone. Adding `needs-merge-eyes` label. I'll follow up if anything else.
